findings.statement: CA9 ranks 1 in the convergence ranking (score 4.5197). In tumor, RCC cells hold 0.976 of tissue transcripts, with 54.7% of RCC cells expressing it and a cpm_share of 0.958; tumor-cell vs proximal-tubule pseudobulk log2FC is 7.739 (padj 0.0189, 6 donors). The bulk signal is tumor-intrinsic.

The CA9 bulk signal survives extrapolation to purity 1 (rna_lfc_at_purity1 7.787, se 0.579; TCGA log2FC 9.712, padj 2.58e-30), so it is not infiltration. No prognostic signal (TCGA Cox log HR -0.009, padj 0.933).

In Visium, CA9 expression is attributed to RCC (composition-corrected share 0.999). Neighbors of high-CA9 spots are enriched in RCC (log2 enrichment 0.381, padj 0.0017) and macrophages (log2 enrichment 0.099, padj 0.0017), so the tumor-cell niche is mostly tumor-on-tumor with some macrophage contact.

The best CA9 site for a molecular glue degrader (MGD) scores 0.546 (pocket volume 126.8 A3, pocket pLDDT 90.3, 1 accessible lysine); the model mean pLDDT is 76.56. Ligand-site recall is 0.5 overall but 0.221 in the top pockets, so this is a modest, small-pocket site. This is a site score only, not evidence that a glue exists or would work.

KDR is carried by endothelium: 0.951 of tissue transcripts, 40.5% of endothelial cells expressing, cpm_share 0.979. It is a microenvironment (vascular) target, not a tumor-cell target. In Visium its expression is explained by endothelial spots (composition-corrected share 0.99).

KDR has the second-highest MGD site score in the candidate ranking (0.841; pocket volume 361.1 A3, pocket pLDDT 83.1, 7 accessible lysines). Caveats: model mean pLDDT 71.12 and ligand-site recall only 0.4 (0.2 in top pockets). RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 1.502 (se 0.483). The site score does not imply a glue exists, and the target cell is endothelial.

CD74 is an immune-cell gene: cDC 100% expressing (cpm_share 0.311), macrophages hold 0.436 of transcripts, and CD8 T cells 0.345. Bulk purity correlation is negative (RNA rho -0.557, padj 9.15e-9) and the RNA log2FC at purity 1 is only 0.561 (se 0.351), so the bulk signal is infiltration-driven, not tumor-cell expression.

CXCR4 transcripts are lymphoid: CD8 T cells hold 0.563 of tissue transcripts (72.9% expressing), CD4 T cells 0.176 (87.8% expressing, highest cpm_share 0.17). It is an immune microenvironment target, not tumor-intrinsic.

Despite being the HIF-2a gene, EPAS1 transcripts in the scRNA-seq are mostly stromal: endothelium 0.365 of transcripts (81.3% expressing, cpm_share 0.626) and fibroblasts 0.081, versus RCC cells 0.051 (4.9% expressing). RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 0.46 (se 0.331), so the bulk RNA signal is not clearly tumor-intrinsic; protein log2FC at purity 1 is 2.367 (se 0.688).

MET is mainly tumor-cell expressed: RCC cells hold 0.935 of transcripts (35.2% expressing, cpm_share 0.682), with endothelium secondary (cpm_share 0.283). Tumor-cell vs proximal-tubule log2FC is 5.237, but padj is 0.069 (6 donors), so not significant at 0.05.

EGFR transcripts sit in RCC cells (0.948 of tissue transcripts, 29.7% expressing, cpm_share 0.542); proximal-tubule cells have a comparable per-cell level (cpm_share 0.312 from only 39 cells), so tumor specificity is weak.

CD70 ranks 3 in convergence (score 4.2143): TCGA log2FC 7.09 (padj 6.45e-25) and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 4.278 (se 0.724), consistent with tumor-intrinsic expression. Clinical drugs exist (phase 1-2 antibody-based agents); prognosis not significant (Cox padj 0.175).

COL23A1 is the top tumor-track first-in-class candidate (novelty 0.767): RCC cells hold 0.881 of tumor transcripts, 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, surface/secreted, max vital-organ nTPM 3 (heart muscle). Replicated in TCGA (log2FC 5.829) and purity-robust (RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 4.88). Caveat: DepMap mean effect 0.167, not a selective dependency, so no functional evidence; literature counted by gene symbol.
Structure does not support a glue campaign for COL23A1: model mean pLDDT 58.91 with only 0.13 confident residues, and the top pocket is 8.0 A3 with MGD score 0.2342 and no ligand-site validation.

RAB42 is the second tumor-track first-in-class candidate (novelty 0.705): RCC cells carry 0.627 of tumor transcripts, only 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, AB/PR tractable, max vital-organ nTPM 2.6 (lung). TCGA log2FC 4.371 and RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 3.189 (purity-robust). Caveat: DepMap mean effect -0.075 and not a selective dependency; no functional evidence.

OLFML2A is a stroma-track candidate (novelty 0.481): fibroblasts hold 0.647 of tumor transcripts, 2 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug, antibody-tractable, but max vital-organ nTPM is 27.9 (colon), an off-tumor consideration. TCGA log2FC 2.372, RNA log2FC at purity 1 of 1.527. Caveat: stromal target, no dependency evidence.

GAL3ST4 is the top immune-track candidate (novelty 0.64): macrophages hold 0.972 of tumor transcripts, 1 ccRCC paper, no clinical drug, antibody-tractable, max vital-organ nTPM 7.4 (cerebral cortex). TCGA log2FC 2.993, but RNA log2FC at purity 1 is only 0.401, and it is adverse in TCGA (Cox log HR 0.177). A macrophage target, not tumor-cell.

GAL3ST4 has a deep, well-modelled top site: MGD score 0.7874, pocket volume 819.7 A3, pocket pLDDT 92.8, 5 accessible lysines (model mean pLDDT 79.31). Caveat: ligand-site validation was not run, so the site is unvalidated; no glue is implied.

LILRB4 is a macrophage-carried immune candidate (0.933 of tumor transcripts, 7 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug) but is flagged infiltration-driven: RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 0.508 versus TCGA log2FC 3.7, so the bulk gain mostly reflects infiltrating cells.

caveats: Discovery candidates are data-ranked hypotheses; none has dependency or functional evidence, and literature counts are by gene symbol.
MGD site scores rank pockets only; they do not show that a glue exists, and ligand-site recall is modest or unchecked for several proteins.
Single-cell group sizes vary widely (e.g. PT 39 cells, Epi_other 18 cells), so per-cell comparisons for those groups are weak.
CD70 single-cell values had no evidence ids, so only bulk/convergence values are quoted for it.
Tumor-vs-proximal-tubule comparison uses 6 donors; MET is not significant at padj 0.05.
